description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, quest.drowned_bells): one of the Mere's five sunken bells, hung from a stone frame by the drowned kings. A giant rings it with a blow (melee only: a hurled boulder or a stomp leaves it silent): the bell swings on its yoke and the runes round its waist light - its rung state is this record's 'broken' stage (no debris, the frame stands), so the quest counts the five world ids destroyed. It sounds of bronze (audio material 'bell').
